plain_language_root_cause: The vertical drift is deterministic: the P-only Lee controller uses 1.1583 kg while the articulated plant weighs 1.1815179586 kg, so a steady downward velocity error is required to command the missing hover force. The available evidence does not identify the cause of the simultaneous horizontal drift, so no complete safe repair is established.
